text:
Paul (Design): quick check on compact routing rules. main problem: when rows collapse the reorder affordance disappears and validation toasts feel disconnected. thinking: persistent small grab icon + inline conflict badge + preview highlight.
Ruth (PM): yup, support asks for "why did this route" frequently. preview should show the matched rule name and short reason.
Ken (Frontend): doable. plan: show a 16px grab icon always in compact mode, expand touch hit area to 44x44, and add a 4px left accent during preview. throttle animations for perf.
Iris (Eng): sim can return rule_name + reason (max 120 chars). backend will truncate safely. recommend only auto-show for first match to avoid noise.
Sam (A11y): a11y notes: announce via role=status with aria-atomic=true; e.g., "Preview: rule 'Block large attachments' matched because file size > 50MB." also ensure focus outlines meet contrast and 3px minimum.
Paul (Design): copy proposal for inline badge: "Conflict with 'Allow - billing' — Show conflict details". prefer inline over global toast.
Ruth (PM): agreed. please file a GH issue with copy + a11y checks.
ux-bot: Issue created  https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing-ui/issues/4999
Ken (Frontend): I'll prototype CSS and aria snippets today and open WIP PR.
Paul (Design): thanks team — will update mock with darker accent (#004EA8) and re-upload. review tomorrow 9:15?
Ruth (PM): scheduled. thanks!
